Zhihui Chen 陈致晖

Ph.D. Student in Artificial Intelligence, National University of Singapore 新加坡国立大学人工智能博士生

PhD student in Artificial Intelligence at the National University of Singapore, supervised by Prof. Mengling Feng.

My research direction is Coding Agent + RSI (recursive self-improvement): coding agents generate, execute and verify real coding tasks, and execution-verified trajectories become training signal for foundation-model post-training — stronger agents help build stronger models. The same line of work extends to medical agents and medical AI safety.

I am currently a foundation-model post-training research intern at Zhipu AI (Z.ai), driving post-training with RSI for coding agents. I have also been selected for the Qwen foundation-model internship (Alibaba Tongyi) and for Tencent’s Qingyun Elite Research Talent Program.

新加坡国立大学人工智能博士生，导师为 冯梦凌教授。

研究方向是 Coding Agent + RSI（递归自进化）：智能体生成、执行并验证真实编码任务，经执行验证的轨迹成为基座模型后训练的训练信号——更强的智能体帮助构建更强的模型。同一研究方向也延伸到医疗 Agent 与医疗 AI 安全。

现于智谱（Z.ai）基础模型后训练团队实习，以 RSI 驱动 Coding Agent 方向的大模型后训练；同时已获阿里通义 Qwen 基座模型实习与腾讯「青云计划」精英科研人才计划。

Research 研究方向

Direction 01 · Coding Agents & Recursive Self-Improvement 方向一 · Coding Agent 与递归自进化

Stronger coding agents should help build stronger models. 更强的 Coding Agent，应当参与构建更强的模型。

I work on the training pipeline that turns agent execution into model progress: coding agents propose real software tasks and execute them in sandboxes; only trajectories that compile, pass tests, and reproduce are kept as post-training data; the updated model then runs a stronger agent in the next round. Whether the loop actually improves the model depends on three problems I study: long-horizon credit assignment, reward and verifier design, and independent auditing of agent actions. 我研究把智能体执行转化为模型进步的训练流程：Coding Agent 生成真实编码任务并在沙箱中执行；只有能编译、能通过测试、能复现的轨迹才保留为后训练数据；更新后的模型在下一轮运行更强的智能体。这个循环能否真正提升模型，取决于我研究的三个问题——长程任务的信用分配、奖励与验证器的设计、对智能体行动的独立审查。

Agent proposes a real coding task 智能体生成真实编码任务 → Sandbox execution 沙箱执行 → Compile · test · replay 编译 · 测试 · 复现 → Keep only verified trajectories 仅保留通过验证的轨迹 → SFT · RL post-training SFT · RL 后训练 → Stronger model → stronger agent 更强模型 → 更强智能体

↺ One verified round produces one model update; the loop works only if every step can be checked. 每轮通过验证后更新一次模型；循环有效的前提是每一步都可检验。

Direction 02 · Medical Agents & Medical AI Safety 方向二 · 医疗 Agent 与医疗 AI 安全

Make self-improvement verifiable where feedback is costly: medicine. 把自进化带进反馈昂贵、必须可验证的医疗场景。

Medicine is a setting where errors are costly and every check may face clinical review, so self-improvement there has to be verifiable. I work on two lines: medical agents — multimodal reasoning, tool use, and verifiable clinical workflows — and medical AI safety — image integrity, interpretable forgery detection, and rigorous evaluation of agent outputs. 医疗场景出错代价高，每一步都可能面对临床检验，自进化在这里必须可验证。我沿两条线推进：医疗 Agent——多模态推理、工具调用与可验证的临床工作流；医疗 AI 安全——影像真实性、可解释的伪造检测与智能体输出的严格评估。

Medical task (image / workflow) 医疗任务（影像 / 工作流） → Agent acts: multimodal reasoning + tools Agent 执行：多模态推理 + 工具调用 → Verifier checks against clinical criteria 验证器按临床标准检查 → Feedback → recursive prompt refinement 反馈驱动 Prompt 递归优化 → Trajectory-based post-training 成败轨迹后训练 → More reliable medical agent 更可靠的医疗 Agent

↺ Verifier feedback drives recursive prompt self-improvement; success-and-failure trajectories then become post-training signal. 验证反馈驱动 Prompt 递归自优化；成败轨迹再成为后训练信号。
